messages:
alex: Pushed docs PR that updates SDK snippet (python + ts) and a small migration guide tweak. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2417. Want to merge during tomorrow's docs merge window (09:00 PST). Who can review? :wave:

ci-bot: Netlify preview created: https://app.netlify.com/sites/redwood-docs/deploys/5f3a2... (preview link). Build status: failed (asset 404s)

jun: Seeing 404s for chunked assets on the preview. Looks like _next/static hash changed vs published manifest. Small notes in build log:
```
10:23:45 ERROR 404 GET /_next/static/chunks/pages/migration-abc.js
Error: ENOENT: no such file or directory, stat '/opt/build/repo/.next/server/pages/migration-abc.js'
```

maria: Hmm. I hit this locally before. Try clearing .next and node_modules then rebuild: `rm -rf .next node_modules && npm ci && npm run docs:build` Also our Netlify cache can cause stale manifests.

alex: Good call. Is there a way to force Netlify to invalidate cache for this deploy? I don't want to re-run CI for trivial fix.

netlify-bot: You can trigger a redeploy from Netlify UI or re-run the "deploy-preview" GitHub Action. To force cache disable set env var `NETLIFY_USE_CACHE=false` on the deploy.

sam: I can re-run the GH action and set that env var. Doing it now.

ci-bot: Re-run started. Logs: `building static assets...`

jun: Also small SDK snippet in python had `client = Redwood()` but our constructor is `RedwoodClient()`. I'll push a quick commit to the PR branch to avoid reviewer friction.

alex: Thanks. Please ping when preview is green.

maria: Local preview for reviewers: `git checkout pr/2417 && npm ci && npm run docs:dev` If you prefer Docker:
```
docker build -t docs-preview .
docker run --rm -p 3000:3000 docs-preview
```

sam: Preview is now green and artifact 404 fixed. Link: https://deploy-preview-2417--redwood-docs.netlify.app/migration

olivia: I can take the review. Will scan for wording/consistency and the SDK snippets.

olivia: Nit: migration guide section 'Dedicated' -> 'dedicated capacity' to be consistent across site. Also add one-line example for typescript client usage.

alex: Thanks all. Planning to merge at 09:00 PST tomorrow unless any objections. @olivia @maria can you approve before then?

olivia: Approving after one last small TS example edit.

maria: Approved. :+1:

ci-bot: Merge PR 2417 to main scheduled for 09:00 PST 1790001250.

alex: Merged. Thanks everyone! :tada:
